PassAnswer.description: Send the request or the reply on as it is.

headers.description: Response headers to add when this answers a reply, each named `x-...`.
headers.title: Headers

RefuseAnswer.description: Send nothing on, and answer the caller with an error.

status.description: The HTTP status of the error.
status.title: Status

headers.description: Response headers to add to the error, each named `x-...`.
headers.title: Headers

RefuseAnswer.title: RefuseAnswer

ReplaceAnswer.description: Send this body on in place of the one that was sent.

body.description: A JSON object for a request, and base64 for a reply.
body.title: Body

headers.description: Response headers to add when this answers a reply, each named `x-...`.
headers.title: Headers

ReplaceAnswer.title: ReplaceAnswer

ReplyMessage.description: A provider's reply, held whole before the caller is sent any of it. It is answered with a `PassAnswer`, a `ReplaceAnswer` or a `RefuseAnswer`.

version.description: The version of these messages. A message in another version is not read.
version.title: Version

id.description: The `id` of the request this is the reply to.
id.title: Id

status.description: The HTTP status of the provider's reply.
status.title: Status

content_type.description: The reply's content type, which says whether it is one JSON object or a stream of events.
content_type.title: Content Type

ReplyMessage.title: ReplyMessage

RequestMessage.description: A model request, sent before it goes to the provider. It is answered with a `PassAnswer`, a `ReplaceAnswer` or a `RefuseAnswer`.

version.description: The version of these messages. A message in another version is not read.
version.title: Version

id.description: Shared by a request and its reply.
id.title: Id

provider.description: The provider whose format the body is in, such as `anthropic` or `openai`.
provider.title: Provider

model.description: The model, by the name the proxy shows for it.
model.title: Model

user.description: Who the proxy signed the caller in as.
user.title: User

run.description: The run the request belongs to, where the proxy can tell. A sentinel's state is kept by run.
run.title: Run

headers.description: The caller's request headers the proxy passes on, without credentials. They are the caller's claims.
headers.title: Headers
